subject: Launch commit tiers, POC credits and rebate structure
messages:
From: Kate Li <kate@brightmetrics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hernandez <tomh@brightmetrics.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 18:12:00 -0500
Subject: Inquiry: commit tiers + pilot credits for our launch

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're lining up our Q2 2027 launch and evaluating hosting options for the inference stack. A couple quick questions as we build the ROI: 

- If BrightMetrics commits to 400M tokens/month for the first 6 months (increasing to 700M/month after launch), what per-token discount tiers do you offer for hosted API usage? Any stepped volume rebates?
- We want to run a 6-week POC for our anomaly detection pipeline. Would Redwood provide pilot credits or a short-term credit slab tied to the commit?
- Any standard ramp/overage policy we should expect during launch month?

Can you share a simple proposal that shows: committed tier pricing, recommended ramp schedule, POC credits, and any launch incentives (free tokens or rebate structure) you could extend?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we need a procurement-ready estimate for our procurement team by next Thursday.

Thanks,
Kate
Kate Li
Director, ML Platforms
BrightMetrics
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Li <kate@brightmetrics.com>
Cc: Tom Hernandez <tomh@brightmetrics.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: commit tiers + pilot credits for our launch

Hi Kate — great to hear from you and congrats on the launch plans. High level answers below; attaching a concise proposal PDF with numbers and a three-step ramp.

Short answers:
- Commit tiers: we offer stepped per-token discounts that increase with commit size. For the volumes you mentioned, the anchor pricing would be: base hosted list price (no commit): $0.00012/token.
  - 200M–499M tokens/month: 10% off list
  - 500M–999M tokens/month: 20% off list
  - 1B+ tokens/month: 30% off list
- Pilot credits: we can provide up to $25k in free credits for a 6-week POC tied to an executed Letter of Intent and a minimum 6‑month commit (you can choose a lower floor if needed, we should discuss).
- Ramp & overage: standard is to allow a 40% burst above commit in the first 30 days with overage priced at list until the next billing period’s usage pushes you into a higher tier; we can include a one‑time launch credit to cover expected overage.

I also propose a launch rebate: if BrightMetrics meets 95% of the 6‑month aggregate commit, we will issue a 5% rebate on billed usage for those months, payable as account credit. With a 12‑month commit we can increase that rebate to 8% and add a one‑time onboarding credit equivalent to ~50M tokens.

I put the details into BRG_commits_and_rebates_v1.pdf attached.

If that frame looks okay I can loop in Laura for pricing approval of the final numbers and the rebate cadence. Would you be available for a 30-minute call tomorrow to review?

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: BrightMetrics commit/rebate ask — approval request

Laura / Vanessa,

Forwarding BrightMetrics' ask — they're asking for pilot credits ($25k), stepped per-token discounts (20% at 500–999M), a temporary 40% burst allowance during launch, and a 5% rebate if they hit 95% of the six‑month aggregate. I'm proposing the 6‑month commit floor and offering the onboarding credit only on a 12‑month signed commitment.

Key risks: rebate increases churn risk if we make it refundable; credits impact first‑month margin. They are a credible mid‑market account with a likely enterprise expansion path. Can we approve this structure (pilot credits + 5% 6m rebate / 8% 12m + onboarding credit) as written, or do we need to alter thresholds / timing?

Thanks,
Rishi

-----Forwarded message attached: BRG_commits_and_rebates_v1.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: BrightMetrics commit/rebate ask — approval request

Rishi,

Thanks for the context and the attached proposal. I'm fine with the structure with two adjustments:

1) Pilot credits capped at $20k (not $25k) for a 6‑week POC tied to an LOI; any additional POC support to be covered via professional services or incremental credits approved by Sales Ops.
2) Rebate earned only after the 6‑month aggregate is verified by usage reports and audited by our billing team; rebate will be issued as account credit, not cash, and applied within 45 days of verification.

Keep the 40% burst allowance but cap total billable overage for month 1 to the lesser of 40% burst or $30k — that protects margin on unanticipated spikes.

With those changes, get me a final pdf and I'll sign off. Also include a line showing how the 12‑month package improves economics (8% rebate + 50M onboarding credit).

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Pricing | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Li <kate@brightmetrics.com>
Cc: Tom Hernandez <tomh@brightmetrics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Final proposal: commit tiers, POC credits, and launch rebate (BRG-2026-045)

Hi Kate / Tom —

Thanks for the quick review. Per our internal approval, attached is the final BRG_commits_and_rebates_v1.pdf reflecting the agreed guardrails:

- Commit tiers: 10% (200M–499M), 20% (500M–999M), 30% (1B+).
- Pilot credits: $20k for a 6‑week POC tied to an LOI (instead of $25k).
- Launch burst: 40% allowed first month; billable overage capped at $30k for month 1.
- Rebate: 5% back as account credit if 95%+ of 6‑month aggregate is achieved, paid within 45 days after audit. 12‑month commit alternative: 8% rebate + one‑time 50M token onboarding credit.

Next steps: if that works, please sign the attached LOI (we've included DocuSign link in the PDF) and we'll provision the POC credits and a dedicated onboarding session with Solutions Engineering.

I'll set up a 30‑minute kickoff after the LOI is counter‑signed.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: BRG_commits_and_rebates_v1.pdf, BrightMetrics_MAAP_requirements.xlsx
